_comment: Recorded CodeSearchResponse carrying a state the client has never heard of — the shape a future coordinator release takes when it adds a seventh CodeSearchState. This is the only recorded response whose `state` is deliberately outside ri-03's enum, which is why its case declares no `service_state`: the case schema mirrors the KNOWN states, and an unknown one is by definition unnameable there. ri-12's UNKNOWN_STATE_FALLBACK makes the mapping total, so this degrades to (unavailable, unknown_state) and never to an injection. Note that `results` is deliberately NON-EMPTY: a client that read the results before checking the state would render them, and this case exists to prove ri-12 does not.
